text:
Alex: Quick thread 10: thinking through marketplace vs private for hybrid offers (hardware + reserved capacity + SI services). Need clear routing rules so sellers don't overpromise.

Jules: TL;DR: Marketplace for self-serve bundles < $200k ARR. Private for anything with on-prem key custody, escrow, or regulated data residency (GovCloud).

Kavita: add note: if SI wants to show partner margin at checkout, marketplace UI can't do that. Handle partner split off-invoice via Partner Portal credits.

Marco: billing cadence mismatch again. Customers expect monthly retainer draws; marketplace invoicing is annual by default. Propose virtual SKU representing 12-month retainer but reconciled monthly server-side.

Sofia: that sounds ok but ops must own reconciliation. Also: what if marketplace capacity/quotas are exhausted? Auto-fail to private PO with 48h notice to seller. We need a migration playbook.

PartnersBot: FYI: security review required for hardware-bundled SKUs. Ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/PRT-5109

Alex: routing rules draft: 1) Escrow or KMS required -> private PO. 2) >$200k ARR -> private PO unless seller explicitly requests marketplace opt-in. 3) Hybrid offers with SI services and hardware -> marketplace virtual SKU only if no KMS/escrow and partner accepts off-invoice credits. 4) Marketplace quota hit -> auto-create private PO, notify seller and partner_ops, 48h buffer.

Jules: renewal path: if started on virtual SKU, surface renewal option to convert to formal commit with tiered discounts (5/10/15% at 12/24/36 mo increases). Sales enablement needs a renewal script and widget.

Kavita: telemetry: emit "offer_convert_candidate" when usage >=70% of committed band for 45 days OR projected run-rate >= commit band for next 30d. Attach customer_id, sku, current_band.

Marco: legal: need standard clause in SKU T&Cs: "Marketplace virtual SKUs may be transitioned to private terms for onboarding, escrow, or compliance reasons; partner commissions may be adjusted per partner agreement." Kavita will loop Legal.

Sofia: marketing wants co-announce with partners for any public marketplace listing. Timeline: SKU approval + partner signoff ready 3 weeks before publish.

Alex: action items: Jules -> draft migration playbook + seller notification template (due Wed). Kavita -> legal clause draft (due Fri). Marco -> telemetry spec + sample alert payload (due Tue). Sofia -> announce timeline and partner assets checklist (due Thu). I'll open routing-policy PR and tag everyone.

PartnersBot: PR opened: https://redwood.internal/prs/8134  partnerships/routing-policy-hybrid-offers (Alex).
